title: Groth16 under-constrained signal in multi-gate non-linear Circom constraint
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0481: Groth16 under-constrained signal in multi-gate non-linear Circom constraint
Repository: `iden3/snarkjs`
Category: `Zero-Knowledge & Cryptographic Constraints`
Target File: `circuits/scalar_mul.circom`

#### Problem Description
Intermediate wire not constrained to binary range permitting adversary to forge non-zero witness proof.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Add explicit b * (1 - b) === 0 binary constraint for all decomposed bits.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0481.py -q`
expected_invariant: Add explicit b * (1 - b) === 0 binary constraint for all decomposed bits.
